status: pre-registered before the runs; results go in a separate file
subject: assets/road/runtime_fullwidth_100m_rough_marked_2mm_20cm_heightmap_v1
what_changes_from_the_last_passing_run: roughness 3 mm to 2 mm (RMS 1.047 to 0.702 mm) and source grid 10 cm to 20 cm, both on native heightmap collision. Same seed, same 145 paint polygons, same ROI.
recommendation_on_record: I recommended running the repeat on the 3 mm scene, which already has one passing full-area run, because roughness amplitude is the pitch excitation and changing it confounds the hypothesis test. The user chose the 2 mm candidate, with acceptance as the priority. Recorded so the results are read accordingly.

runs.stack: GUI + RViz + OptiX, tools/validate_operator_session.py, pause probe on, cancel probe off
runs.seed_rationale: the three section 6 used, so one seed cannot carry the result

acceptance_gates: ten tracks each, zero unverified segments, zero quality flags
peak RSS under 20 GiB and card under 10 GiB
geometry_alerts_are_tallied_not_gating: A camera/encoder geometry alert is reported for review, split by phase (steady scan, start, pause recovery) and by region (ROI against lead-in and run-out). The conservative combined gate stays until the criterion is agreed; a geometry alert is not renamed a capture failure or confirmed tyre slip.

pitch_hypothesis.claim_under_test: the camera/encoder ratio deficit is the pitching reference frame, not contact sliding
pitch_hypothesis.evidence_it_rests_on: six matched startup probes: first-second encoder minus body 12.14-12.38 mm against a 12.47-12.71 mm small-angle height*pitch estimate, residual -0.31 to -0.32 mm, with contact tangential travel of 0.14-0.20 mm
pitch_hypothesis.transfers_if: every full-area alert falls in an acceleration or pause-recovery phase AND the residual after the height*pitch estimate stays below 1 mm
pitch_hypothesis.does_not_transfer_if: any alert occurs at steady speed inside the ROI, or any residual exceeds 1 mm
pitch_hypothesis.untested_if: zero alerts occur across all three runs. B is then accepted and the hypothesis is NOT confirmed: lowering roughness lowers the excitation the hypothesis is about, so absence of alerts is absence of evidence. The hypothesis would remain testable only on the 3 mm scene.
pitch_hypothesis.residual_formula: tools/summarize_startup_contact.py: rocking = -mean(body_z)*delta_pitch, residual = encoder - body_x - rocking. Defined against body x, while the alert ratio uses camera x; the alert stores raw terms so either convention can be derived.

instrumentation_added_for_this_series: The plugin now applies the audit's test online over each pose-tag interval against the same 0.95 floor and dumps the two-second window on an alert, because by the time the offline audit runs that window is gone. Geometry alerts carry their own dump budget so expected pass-start alerts cannot starve a scan-motion dump. The event stores raw terms, not a verdict.
accepted_limitations: The instance is not freshly restarted and ages about an hour across the series; RTF is compared within the series, not against section 6 fresh-instance figures.
B has no prior motion history. A support probe over x = -12 to 110 was run first and matched the declared [-9.4, 109.2] bounds.
Three runs establish a range, not a rate.
if_b_passes: B becomes the production default, which re-bases results taken at 3 mm: the suspension damping excitation baseline, ROUGH_ROAD_PROBE, and the camera mount 150/300 comparison. Those need re-basing notes at the same time, not later.
